name: mcp-scanner-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is MCP Scanner, a Python tool and SDK that scans MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers,
tools, prompts and resources for security threats and production-readiness issues. This task covers its scanning core:
the analyzers (readiness, YARA, prompt defense and the service-backed analyzers), the threat taxonomy, static
scanning of MCP JSON files, scan results and their JSON and report formats, configuration, authentication, the command
line and the REST API.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
The code in scope is these Python modules of the mcpscanner package: mcpscanner/__init__.py, mcpscanner/cli.py and mcpscanner/server.py; every module in mcpscanner/api/, mcpscanner/config/, mcpscanner/threats/ and mcpscanner/utils/; mcpscanner/core/__init__.py, mcpscanner/core/auth.py, mcpscanner/core/exceptions.py, mcpscanner/core/mcp_models.py, mcpscanner/core/models.py, mcpscanner/core/report_generator.py, mcpscanner/core/result.py and mcpscanner/core/scanner.py; and every module directly in mcpscanner/core/analyzers/ and in mcpscanner/core/analyzers/readiness/. The documentation in scope is README.md, the pages docs/api-reference.md, docs/architecture.md, docs/authentication.md, docs/logging.md, docs/mcp-threats-taxonomy.md, docs/output-formats.md, docs/programmatic-usage.md, docs/programmatic_exception_handling.md, docs/readiness-scanning.md and docs/static-scanning.md, and the module, class and function docstrings of the
